packages.name: Express Wash
packages.summary: A scratch-safe hand wash and dry, wheels and glass, done in under an hour while the car sits in your driveway.
included: Snow-foam pre-soak to lift grit before anything touches the paint
Two-bucket hand wash with grit guards
Wheel faces, tires and arches cleaned with their own brushes
Deionised rinse that dries without water spots
Filtered-air blow dry, then a plush microfiber pass
Exterior glass and mirrors
Satin tire dressing

packages.name: Full Detail
packages.summary: Inside and out: decontaminated paint with three months of sealant, and a vacuumed, wiped and steamed cabin.
included: Everything in the Express Wash
Iron fallout remover and clay bar decontamination
Spray sealant, about three months of protection
Door jambs, fuel door and tailgate shuts
Full vacuum, including under the seats and the trunk
Steamed vents, cupholders, consoles and door pockets
Dash and trim cleaned and left with a non-greasy UV finish
Streak-free glass inside and out

packages.name: Interior Deep Clean
packages.summary: Hot-water extraction for seats and carpets, steam for every hard surface, leather cleaned and conditioned.
included: Compressed-air blowout of seams, rails and vents
Hot-water extraction of carpets, mats and cloth seats
Leather cleaned with a soft brush, then conditioned
Steam on consoles, buttons, cupholders and door cards
Headliner spot-cleaned by hand
Enzyme treatment for food, pet and sports-kit odors
Pet hair removal
Glass and screens cleaned with the right products for each

packages.name: Paint Correction
packages.summary: Machine polishing that removes swirls, haze and light scratches instead of filling them. Measured, taped and inspected under lights.
included: Paint depth readings on every panel before we polish
Full wash, iron and clay decontamination
Trim, badges and edges taped off
Machine compound and polish, stage by stage
Inspection under our own LED panel lights between steps
Panel wipe to show the true finish, with no fillers
Sealant to protect the corrected paint
Before and after photos of your car

packages.name: Ceramic Coating
packages.summary: A one-step correction, then a five-year ceramic coating on paint, wheel faces and glass, cured under infrared lamps.
included: Full decontamination wash
One-step machine polish to refine the paint first
Panel wipe so the coating bonds to bare clear coat
Five-year ceramic coating on all painted surfaces
Wheel faces and calipers coated
Hydrophobic glass coating on the windshield
Infrared lamp curing, so it is rain-ready the next morning
A free check-up wash at three months
